about: How Pear goes into LG Home (webOS 6). Read by installer/patch_home.py on your computer and tv/update.js on the TV. Each edit's `old` must match exactly once; `optional` ones may be absent; `end` inserts before the file's final closing brace.

UserInterfaceLayer/Containers/MainView.q.why: LG's views stay loaded (and show in Edit Home) so launching, ordering and editing keep working; Pear draws over them
whatever LG hands focus to lands on its ribbon; send it to Pear instead
LG's scroll indicator stays hidden under Pear (webOS 6.5 has none)
Pear's Home, loaded over LG's just before MainView's closing brace

UserInterfaceLayer/UIController.qml.why: power-on opens the full Home and leaves it up, instead of a half Home that closes itself after 8 seconds
the same, for the other way into a half Home
